verdict.rationale: Factory's built-in agent, Droid, is the core of the product. Its docs describe delegating tasks from the App or terminal, reviewing diffs and merging, handing scoped tasks to Custom Droids, and assigning Linear or Jira issues to Droid to investigate, implement, and test. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Delegate a task, review the diff, and merge from the App or your terminal.
delegate scoped tasks to Custom Droids via /droids
Assign a Linear issue to Factory or mention `@Factory` in an issue comment to have Droid investigate, implement, and test the work.
start an interactive terminal session, and delegate a first scoped task.
